title: Show HN: A static, client-side tarot calculator for Brazilian Portuguese
summary: A static, client-side web application that generates tarot card readings and interpretations in Brazilian Portuguese. The site uses only front-end technologies without any backend server, making it lightweight, fast, and privacy-friendly by keeping all calculations in the user's browser.
problem_solved: Makes tarot readings accessible to Brazilian Portuguese speakers without requiring server infrastructure or external API calls.
why_valuable: Provides a free, instant, and privacy-conscious tarot experience with zero backend dependencies and full offline capability.
